fields.description:
– How to manage conflicts between doing good and doing well

How can you overcome dilemmas between sustainability and business? How do you avoid being hit by a CSR crisis and what to do when the watchdog bites? 

At our miniconference on the 29th of November 2016 we explored some of the complex dilemmas companies are facing when doing good and doing well and got inspired by how real-life cases succeed in managing CSR crises.

name: Video presentation by Tania Ellis (The Social Business Company)

fields.description:
How can you overcome dilemmas and conflicts between doing good and doing well? How do you avoid being hit by a CSR crisis? And what do you do when the watchdogs bite?  
Watch this video with Tania Ellis, Founder and Special Adviser of The Social Business Company, to get an overview of global trends and cases of CSR crises and dilemmas. 

Read the full blog post about how you can avoid CSR crises at:
https://www.taniaellis.com/csr-crises-dilemmas/
